details: Old worker protocol, old guest helper, and runner setup bugs were found during disposable fixture preparation. No green result is substituted for these runs.
Provider returned Bad Gateway during a tool-using turn; the demo was interrupted and its sandbox deleted.
Managed network service exited during npm installation; settings copy then failed with No route to host. The failure was not reproduced as a passing extended Linux run.
The isolated supervisor was still opening its store when the API demo attempted allocation.
The restarted daemon attempted duplicate host-service attachment. It failed closed; saved listener rebinding now skips duplicate registration.
The agent completed after a follow-up, but host preview returned HTTP 502. Earlier Mac run 2 preview passed; this later failed observation remains failed.
The demo tried the guest CLI before native harness installation completed. The next demonstration waits for the real CLI file.
Concurrent npm metadata downloads stalled; the disposable run was interrupted. Enrollment now limits npm to one download socket.
Restart and public MCP invocation passed, but the revocation action had no canonical route. The route is now generated and run 8 observed revocation refusal.
CLI attach displayed output, but disconnect returned 1 during a canceled follow-up read. Cancellation now returns 0; run 8 observed the released lease.
One other Firecracker VM was live and available memory was 10337 MiB, below the owner-required 12288 MiB. The run stopped before sandbox allocation.
